note: Design round 10 (v12-totem.md 3.0-3.5), the shape, the option picked on 2026-11-03: totem-idol. rows are copied from the design's totem-shape.json verbatim, as build-10.mjs drew them after the picks with the owner's two amendments (3.0): alone, the idol is centred in its well (form A: the wings around a two-cell face with a • eye in each half); beside its mark it shifts left (form B: the picked cells, the ¨ eyes, and the mark in the well's last cell: the last day's yellow ! or the pop's white ✦); and no count is ever drawn on the totem, as a Totem of Undying does not stack, so r-two and l-two-23h carry exactly the totem cells of r-safe and l-safe-23h. Each row is the full HUD (5 lines, roles top, hearts, xp, hot, edge): dist/hungerbar.mjs rendering the situation's payload in the media rig's sandbox (scripts/media/rig.mjs, the normal day of scripts/media/scenes/looks.mjs with hud.pr on, align left, user off) with hud.totem off, then the option painted onto the feature's cells by the moves of design 2.2; spaces are U+00A0, as Hungerbar prints them. situations are the design's inputs: the 5-hour window's used %, the week (60% left), the credits, the totems declared (n, kind, ends in hours), ctx.pop (the age of the pop in seconds: 0 it fell now, 30 over; null no fall seen) and ctx.until (the reset's end, epoch seconds). test/unit/hud-totem.test.ts renders each through Hungerbar with hud.totem on and the totems declared, and compares span for span.
name: The golden idol
optionNote: The Totem of Undying as the game draws it: a small gold figure with raised wings and green eyes.
title: The shape
intro: The totem is a limit reset Anthropic gave you (Settings → Usage → Resets), which you declare once with hungerbar totem 1 --until 2026-12-01, because Claude Code does not pass resets to status lines. It waits in hotbar slot 5. When a limit it can refill drops to 10% left or less, it moves to your offhand, which holds one thing, and the emerald (your credits, in dollars) moves to slot 5: a reminder to use the reset instead of paying. At 0 its sides turn gold. The HUD never uses a reset for you. Pick the shape the totem is drawn as.
